escena: SCENE (the art director's correction pass, studio in Lima, evening): a large printed layout fills the frame at a steep raking angle on the table, its coated paper catching a hard low light from the left so the fibre and the ink surface read sharp. Across it run the marks of the pass in ORANGE grease pencil, pressed hard enough to leave a physical ridge: a circle around one element, an arrow dragging it down and across, a firm double crossing-out, a bracket in the margin. Caught at the exact instant the last stroke ends: the wax of that final bracket still sits raised and wet-bright on the paper, and the hand that drew it is already leaving as a blurred fragment at the far top edge, never the subject. At the far edge, out of focus, a monitor glows azure blue with the same layout open. 50mm at f/4, focus on the orange marks. The type on the layout is real but tiny and lies outside the focal plane, unreadable. Everything is completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the pale polished concrete floor rising into the bottom of the frame right at the lens
lecho.tono: VERY LIGHT almost white polished concrete
